This research is a parallel type clinical trial and was performed after obtaining permission and written presentation of the ethics committee of the University. The study population consisted of hemodialysis patients in dialysis centers in Tehran hospitals from whom 96 men and women were selected according to inclusion and exclusion criteria. They were willingness to participate in the research, having a healthy sense of smell, lack of allergic rhinitis or respiratory problems, lack of skin sensitivity to aromatic herbs, no drug abuse, no chronic physical disorders such as debilitating cardiovascular, respiratory, hepatic or mental diseases, death of the patient during the study, and kidney transplant. Sampling was performed based on odd and even days of the week at two work shifts of morning and evening. The samples were then randomly assigned in three groups of aroma inhalation, essence massage, and control. Aroma inhalation (lavender and orange) and essence massage was done 3 times weekly for 8 weeks. The patients were also taken the routine care of the ward. The control group only received the routine care. The data were collected using the Rhoten Fatigue Scale and the Kidney Disease Quality of Life instrument; they were completed by the researcher before the intervention and one and two months after it. The data were analyzed with SPSS and statistical tests.

title: The effect of antenatal perineal massage on perineal traumas during childbirth and pelvic floor function in primiparous women
index_summary: Study aim: This study aim to determine the effect of antenatal perineal massage on perineal traumas during childbirth and pelvic floor function in primiparous women. Design: The randomized, single-blind, parallel-group clinical trial will consist of the intervention and the control groups (83 participants in each group). In each center, using the Integrated Health Record System (SIB), a list of the study population who meet the inclusion criteria will be prepared. Randomization will be done using stratified block randomization. In each stratum, random assignment of the selected samples to the experimental and the control groups will be performed using blocks of four. Settings and conduct: In six health centers of Minab city, perineal massage training will be provided to the intervention group. Ten minutes Perineal massage will be performed every other day, between 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM, from week 34 of pregnancy until labor contractions begin. Before the intervention and 6 weeks after the delivery, the Pelvic Floor Distress inventory-20 (PFDI-20), also, in the delivery room, the medical and obstetric history questionnaire will be completed in both groups. Assessor and the birth attendants will be blinded to allocation of individuals to the intervention and control groups. Participants/Inclusion and exclusion criteria: Inclusion criteria: Age 18-45 years, first pregnancy, singleton pregnancy, gestational age 34 weeks. Exclusion criteria: Contraindications for vaginal delivery, high risk of preterm birth. Intervention groups: The intervention group will receive perineal massage and childbirth preparation training in a 90-minute session. The control group will receive childbirth preparation training in a 60-minute session. Main outcome variables: The mean score of PFDI-20, perineal injuries during delivery, duration of second stage of delivery, perineal pain during delivery
